children: RAKETECH ENTERS INTO AGREEMENT TO SETTLE CASUMBA EARNOUT FOR EUR 8.2 MILLION, AGAINST EUR 20.3 MILLION PAYABLE
SIGNS SANCTION LETTER WITH BANK OF VALLETTA FOR EUR 5.50 MILLION FINANCING
TO HAVE EUR 8.50 MILLION LOANS FROM BANK OF VALLETTA, REPAID OVER THREE YEARS
EXPECTS EUR 12 MILLION FROM CASUMBA AND US ASSET DIVESTMENTS
SETTLEMENT EXPECTED TO RESULT IN SIGNIFICANT NON-RECURRING NON-CASH GAIN IN Q4 2026
